|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Returns absolute [[speed]] of a vehicle in kilometres per hour (km/h).

|s1= [[Object]] call [[BIS_fnc_absSpeed]]

|p1= [[Object]] - vehicle

|r1= [[Number]]

|x1= <sqf>
if (((vehicle player) call BIS_fnc_absSpeed) > 150) then
{
	hint "There goes my driver's license :(";
};
</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
_kmh = (vehicle player) call BIS_fnc_absSpeed;
_mph = _kmh / 1.609344; // miles per hour
</sqf>

|seealso= [[speed]]
